_readme: Copy this file to `program_configuration.json` (SAME directory, no `.example`) and
fill in real credentials. The real file is gitignored so it never gets committed.
Selecting an env: application.properties has `env=stg`. Override with `-Denv=qa`
or `TEST_ENV=qa`. Only the env block matching the active env is loaded.
Config.get(...) resolves keys as `<subsection>.<field>` (e.g. `api_config.client_id`).
Legacy aliases still work: c_id -> api_config.client_id, c_sec -> api_config.client_secret,
salesforce_assertion -> sf_config.assertion, etc.
DATABASE WIRING (required for any test with JDBC steps)
The `database` block below is REQUIRED for any imported SoapUI test that
runs a `sql.execute` / `sql.rows` / `sql.firstRow` Groovy step. Without
it, `Db.isConfigured()` returns false and every JDBC step is silently
skipped -- you will see this in the log:
.. jdbc SKIPPED (DB not configured): <sql>
and any REST step that depends on the JDBC step's state change (activate
account, seed a member row, etc.) will 404 downstream against still-
unprovisioned state.
Derived from the `database` subfields at Config-load time (do NOT set
these directly -- the derivation fills them in):
db.url       = jdbc:<database.scheme>://<database.host>:<database.port>/<database.schema>
db.user      = database.username
db.password  = database.password
db.driver    = database.driver   (default: org.postgresql.Driver)
PostgreSQL driver is bundled in pom.xml. For MySQL / Oracle / SQL Server,
add the matching driver dependency AND set `scheme` + `driver` accordingly:
MySQL       scheme=mysql          driver=com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver
Oracle      scheme=oracle:thin:@  driver=oracle.jdbc.OracleDriver
SQL Server  scheme=sqlserver      driver=com.microsoft.sqlserver.jdbc.SQLServerDriver
Other derived keys (auto-computed):
baseUrl      <- api_config.api_end_point + '/' + api_config.version

__DATABASE_BLOCK_README__: REQUIRED for JDBC steps -- see the `_readme` at the top of this file
for the full explanation. Leave `__SET_ME__` placeholders in place
if you have no DB access; JDBC steps will skip cleanly and any
test that depends on DB state changes will 404 downstream. Fill
in real values to unlock those tests.
